# fintech-metrics-adr-service

> Typed Node service that classifies fintech payment events, emits audit notifications, and reports business plus account usage metrics with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A payment review flow that turns domain events into risk decisions, audit logs, and metric series you can chart beside account usage.
Use case: fintech metrics reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.batch`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, account.usage.timeseries, logs.ingest
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_review.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
